text_blocks.snippet: Portuguese citizenship can be obtained through birth, descent, marriage, or naturalization after a period of legal residency. Individuals born in Portugal automatically acquire citizenship, while those born abroad to Portuguese parents or with a Portuguese grandparent may also be eligible. After five years of legal residency, foreign nationals can apply for citizenship through naturalization, provided they meet certain requirements like demonstrating Portuguese language proficiency and having a clean criminal record.
snippet_highlighted_words: can be obtained through birth, descent, marriage, or naturalization after a period of legal residency

list.snippet: Individuals born in Portugal automatically become Portuguese citizens, regardless of their parents' nationalities.
Those born abroad to at least one Portuguese parent can also acquire citizenship by descent, provided their birth is registered in the Portuguese civil registry, according to Henley & Partners.
Individuals with at least one Portuguese parent can acquire citizenship, even if born outside Portugal.
Those with a Portuguese grandparent who retained their citizenship may also be eligible.
Foreign nationals can apply for citizenship after at least five years of legal residency in Portugal.
Applicants need to demonstrate proficiency in the Portuguese language (at least A2 level).
A clean criminal record is also a requirement.
Actively demonstrating ties to the Portuguese community is beneficial.
Citizenship can also be obtained through marriage or civil union with a Portuguese citizen.
The right to live, work, and study in any EU country.
Visa-free or visa-on-arrival access to over 180 destinations worldwide.
A Portuguese passport provides access to a wide range of travel opportunities.
Dual citizenship is permitted, meaning you can retain your original nationality.

text_blocks.snippet: In essence, Portugal offers a variety of routes to citizenship, catering to individuals with different connections to the country and varying levels of residency experience.
